question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2023 Q1b(ii) — Pendulum T² Column
question.text:
Table 1 shows measurements from a simple pendulum experiment. The length l and period T are given. Complete the third column by calculating T² (Period squared) for each row.

Length l (m)Period T (s)Period² T² (s²)
